chunks: As for whatever is in it from Abū Jamīlah, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥimyarī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr al-Bazanṭī, from Abū Jamīlah al-Mufaḍḍal ibn Ṣāliḥ.

key_terms.أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ: A transmitter from whom reports in this section are narrated.
key_terms.الْبَزَنْطِيِّ: A named transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: A named intermediary in the chain of transmission.
key_terms.الْمُفَضَّلِ ابْنِ صَالِحٍ: The personal identification of Abū Jamīlah.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical expression of hadith transmission.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Abū Jamīlah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits reports from Abū Jamīlah in this work. It serves as a technical note of hadith transmission, identifying the intermediaries through whom the narration reached the compiler.
